kisah: In July 1969, three astronauts flew the Apollo 11 mission: Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin, and Michael Collins. Its goal was the national target set by President John F. Kennedy on 25 May 1961: land a human on the Moon and bring them back to Earth.

On 20 July 1969 (U.S. time), Eagle landed in the Sea of Tranquility. Armstrong and Aldrin went down to the surface while Collins stayed in lunar orbit. They walked on the Moon for about 2.5 hours, collecting rock samples and setting up experiments, then flew home and splashed down in the Pacific Ocean on 24 July.

Mars.tujuan: Look for traces of water on Mars
Mars.temuan: The mineral goethite and soil that is 90 percent silica, both linked to water
kisah: In 2003, NASA sent two twin rovers to Mars to look for traces of water. Mars is dry and cold today, but scientists suspected it was once wet. Spirit was sent to Gusev Crater, a large crater that may once have been a lake.

Spirit found the mineral goethite and soil that is 90 percent silica, both linked to water. It got stuck in soft soil on 1 May 2009 and travelled 7.73 km. Its last communication came on 22 March 2010; official recovery efforts ended on 25 May 2011.

Mars.catatan: NASA Science writes 7 July 2003; choose one and note the time zone.
kisah: In 2003, NASA sent two twin rovers to Mars to look for traces of water. Opportunity was sent to Meridiani Planum, a place with minerals that usually form in water.

Opportunity found the mineral hematite and traces of salty water. On 2 March 2004, NASA announced strong evidence that Meridiani Planum was once wet. Opportunity travelled 45.16 km; last contact came on 10 June 2018 during a global dust storm, and NASA declared the mission over on 13 February 2019.

Deep Space.temuan: Carries the Golden Record: greetings in 55 languages, 115 images
kisah: Voyager 1 launched on 5 September 1977 with a mass of 721.9 kg. It entered interstellar space in August 2012, and since 17 February 1998 it has been the most distant human-made object from the Sun.

Voyager 1 carries the Golden Record, a gold-plated copper disc holding greetings in 55 languages, 35 natural sounds, about 90 minutes of music, and 115 images. Its mission has been extended and the spacecraft is still operating, although some instruments have been switched off to save power.

Deep Space.temuan: Flew past Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus (24 January 1986), and Neptune (25 August 1989)
kisah: Voyager 2 launched on 20 August 1977. It flew past Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus (24 January 1986), and Neptune (25 August 1989), then entered interstellar space on 5 November 2018.
Like Voyager 1, Voyager 2 carries the Golden Record. Its mission has been extended and the spacecraft is still operating.
